title: rubus corylifolius f. parvifolius
intro: Rubus corylifolius f. parvifolius, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The Himalayan raspberry is known for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits, including reducing fever and alleviating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Rubus corylifolius f. parvifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
